name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R3 (hard Precedence(blocker_moved, target_picked_up)) does not match any ordering stated in the task. The sentence “Then pick up the box in the other room.” follows the conditional “If you move the ball, you must also take the key.” According to the guideline for a “Then” after an if‑condition, the required clauses are: (i) Existence(target_picked_up) (already present), (ii) hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) – the box must be picked after the key, and (iii) hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) – if the ball is moved, the box must eventually be picked. The current Precedence from blocker_moved to target_picked_up is therefore an added, incorrect requirement. Replace R3 with a hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and add a hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) (or remove the incorrect Precedence if you choose not to encode the extra Response).

texts: If the ball is moved then the key must also be taken (at some point).
Eventually pick up the target box.
The key must be taken before picking up the target box.
If the ball is moved then the target box must eventually be picked up.
